items.title: Three Dividend Giants Beat Q2 Estimates: Which Deserves Your Money?
items.summary: All three dividend heavyweights crushed Q2 estimates on the same morning, yet the market punished one of them with a brutal selloff. The diverging reactions reveal something important about where value actually sits right now.

items.title: NextEra Energy Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: NextEra Energy (NYSE:NEE) reported second-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings per share of $1.15, while adjusted EPS for the first six months of the year rose 9.8% from a year earlier. Chairman, President and CEO John Ketchum said the results reflected continued execution at Florida Power & Light Co.
